race.comment: STYLIN' (2) was solid off a freshen, missing out by 0.2L as the odds-on favourite over 1100m last time out. Out to 1200m isa big tick as she's unbeaten at this track and trip and she'll be fitter for her last start. Needs some luck from the draw, but if the breaks come then she's sure to make her presence felt. LAVISH CHARM (1) is racing well without winning, being caught late last start over 1100m. Li now takes the ride and he'll carry less weight this time. Expected to play a leading role again. DANCEWITHME (11) has missed narrowly her past couple, flying late over 1100m last time out. Likely to get back from the draw yet again, but it shapes similarly to her latest efforts. Nottle sticks and she can feature in the finish yet again. SPANGLEDSTAR (5) is not to be discounted on her recent efforts with the visors on for the first time. RIPPER RUPERT (4) can improve third-up now and into a more suitable race.
